name: Change
job: Show how far a belief moved and which way, readable at a glance and without colour.

anatomy.role: Mono, display size, bold: the headline of the change
Mono, label size: the states behind the change
The 0 to 100 scale the change sits on
Segment and filled head at the end value; the head points the way it moved

states.name: Rise
states.note: Plus sign, arrow points right, green.

states.name: Fall
states.note: True minus sign (U+2212), arrow points left, red.

states.name: No change
states.note: The words no change and a round marker, muted.

states.name: Edge
states.note: Values near 0 and 100 stay inside the track.

use_when: A belief, a score or a confidence moved between two moments and the reader needs the size and direction first.
The before and after values are on one 0 to 100 scale.
avoid_when: The two values are on different scales or units; show them side by side instead.
The value did not move in a way that matters; say so in the sentence and skip the molecule.
You only have colour to offer: this molecule always carries the sign and the arrow.

data.note: Confidence at the end. Points are rounded to whole numbers before the sign is taken.

access: The whole molecule has an aria-label such as `+40 pts, 40% to 80%`; the arrow is hidden from screen readers.
Direction reads three ways: the sign, the arrow head and the colour. Remove any one and it still reads.
Numbers use tabular figures so stacked changes line up.
Not interactive on its own; when it sits inside a button the button carries focus.
gates: `scripts/delta_encoding_gate.py`: every change goes through `pts()` and sets its text beside its colour.
`scripts/kit_specimen.py` in check mode: this page matches its spec.
`scripts/page_gate.py`, `scripts/artifact_wrap_lint.py`, `scripts/token_source_gate.py`, and the impeccable detector at 0 findings.
